prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1333; do not mention it.)
text: This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, email, or in person. We ask that you provide the policy limits of liability coverage applicable to the insured driver, along with a copy of the declarations page for that policy. We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or telematics records, witness statements, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any recorded communications. Please treat this as formal notice that litigation is possible, and confirm in writing within the next fourteen days that you have received this letter and placed a preservation hold on the file.
